CREATE TABLE cohort_summary AS 
SELECT cohort, 
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_size,
       (SELECT contact_notes FROM participants WHERE participants.cohort = cohort LIMIT 1) AS representative_example_comment
FROM participants 
GROUP BY cohort;

UPDATE cohort_summary 
SET representative_example_comment = (SELECT contact_notes FROM participants WHERE cohort_summary.cohort = participants.cohort LIMIT 1);
